He only likes married women, so he demands the prettiest Milf in town. "If you want me to save the city, give me the most beautiful milf" A unique erotic Fantasy story created by a hero!
synonyms: The Hero Wants a Married Woman as a Reward

title.native: 勇者さまは報酬に人妻をご希望です
title.romaji: Yuusha-sama wa Houshuu ni Hitozuma wo Gokibou desu

159424.description: In 1705, a rash of murders takes place in Lotto Valentino, a provincial city on the Italian peninsula. The murderer, who wears a pure white mask and places one such mask on all of their victims, is known as the "Mask Maker," and anyone who witnesses their murders becomes their next victim. Huey Laforet, a boy who attends a "private school" for alchemy, hates everything about the world. Monica Campanella, his schoolmate, confesses her feelings for him. Elmer C. Albatross arrives in town as the school's newest student. Niki, a merchant's slave girl, witnesses one of the Mask Maker's crimes. All four youths must confront the Mask Maker and a conspiracy to control the entire city — the start of a 300-year-long struggle amongst immortals.

159425.description:
Mia Takanashi, heiress to the famed Takanashi Group, has had the world at her feet since birth. With the future of the company to think about, deciding on a marriage partner early would have its advantages. However, just as Mia set her heart on one of several charming suitors, amnesia from a freak car accident sets her back to square one! Four wildly different boys appear before her, claiming to be her intended fiancé, but which one of them did Mia ultimately choose? She may just have to fall in love all over again to find out!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.romaji: Ore to Mou Ichido, First Love.

159426.description:
A girl wants to kill her classmate as revenge for vicious bullying. She decides on "ko-doku", a cruel poisonous curse that requires a sacrifice, as the method of killing....... This is the start of a supernatural story about occult incidents that happen behind the scenes at an all-girls high school, and the activities of an unorthodox dog-possessed girl, Ayumi Kusunose.

(Source: Square-Enix Novels)

159427.description:
Betty, a maid at a luxury hotel, meets a handsome man they called "The Earl." Betty, who dreams of marrying rich, thought that this is her chance! But her destiny changes when she suddenly receives a gift from her grandfather...

(Source: Asuka, translated)

title.native: マジカル・コネクション

159428.description: Higashi Takahashi saves Moeha from being pursued by Kodama, the ace of the basketball club. He is famous for being a weirdo, but before he knew it, he had fallen in love with Moeha!

159430.description:
The theme of this year's Pretty Cure is “The Expanding World." This is an exciting and fun slice-of-life story about Sora Harewataaru, who came from Skyland to Solarseed City, and Mashiro Nijigaoka, a resident of Solarseed City.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ひろがるスカイ！プリキュア

159431.description:
For ten years, Beatrice lived as a saint to protect the empire and earn her family's love. But when Lina steals her position, Beatrice is accused of witchcraft and sentenced to death. In her second life, she vows to get revenge. Thus begins Beatrice's transformation!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Saintess Returns as a Villain

title.english: The Saint Reborn as the Villain

159432.description:
One day, Kiyoko, an eccentric, anti-social psychologist, receives a suicide note. Her former and only friend's final request is for her to take in two siblings, Haruto and Rion, who will become "suicide orphans." A sorrowful yet funny family story spun by three people under one roof, whose lives are very far from the "normal happiness."

(Source: BeLove, translated)

159433.description:
Born under the Star of Darkness, Princess Baekseon always knew she was fated for something big, but it’s only after she disguises herself as a boy and leaves the safety of the palace that she begins to see just how big. Malicious old hags, cheerful goblins, lovesick witches, and the promise of a mysterious soulmate with red and blue eyes are just the beginning: ultimately, what hangs in the balance is the fate of the world itself.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

159435.description:
Charlotte Rania thought she'd be free to enjoy her life as an unimportant side character... until she saves a dying boy, who turns out to be Theodore Heinst, the younger brother of the male lead! Despite her reluctance to get involved with said male lead, Duke Carlyle Heinst, Charlotte has no choice but to help him when she discovers that mysterious forces are trying to kill Theodore. It doesn't take long for her to realize that changing a character's fate comes at a price...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Accidentally Saved the Male Lead's Brother
男主人公の弟、うっかりと助けちゃいました
ฉันเผลอช่วยน้องชายของคุณพระเอกเอาไว้
三岁小鬼带我逆袭成公爵夫人

title.english: I Accidentally Saved the Male Lead's Brother

159436.description:
Lyrica is a hardworking 8-year-old girl who has always used her vivid imagination to escape the harsh realities of living in the slums with her neglectful mother. After her mother has a premonition of a disastrous future, she snaps to her senses and devises a plan to provide a different life for Lyrica. But even Lyrica couldn't have imagined that the plan was to marry the emperor! Now that she has everything she could ever dream of, can Lyrica face reality in spite of her wild imagination?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Mom Entered a Contract Marriage
My Mother Got Married By Contract
เมื่อคุณแม่ของฉันทำสัญญาวิวาห์
母が契約結婚しました
Le Dragon, la fleur et le mage

159437.description:
After being taken in by the noble house of Nacht, Sienna grew up with her adopted sister, Lorena, who she believed to be the sweetest, kindest person in the world. But after Lorena attempts to kill her, Sienna realizes how much her "loving" sister actually hated her. She tries to end her life with a magic potion but ends up going back in time instead. Determined to survive, she tries to use her memories to her advantage. For some strange reason though... Lorena is now nowhere to be found.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The World Without My Sister Who Everyone Loved
The World Where the Beloved Sister Disappeared

159438.description:
After 30% of Korea's population was massacred by monsters, Players were the people's last hope. In a battle against those monsters, a Player named Noh Eunha was on the verge of death, but he was miraculously sent back to when he was a baby! Now that he knows what's to come, he's building up the mana he lacked in his past life while trying to convince his parents not to make the same choices that led to their deaths. But how can a 6-year-old Eunha convince his parents that he knows best?

(Source: Tapas)

159439.description:
Seong-Yun Han was just a boy when his parents were killed by monsters unleashed during a mysterious calamity called the “Dungeon Break.” Seven years later, Seong-Yun is devastated to find that his grinding efforts to become a Hunter – fierce warriors who seek out and destroy monsters – are entirely in vain, as his fighting attributes have not increased at all. Seong-Yun’s world flips on a dime when he accepts an invitation to join the Tower of Trials, an otherworldly realm where challengers must overcome trials that pit them against monsters and humans alike.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: นักล่าไร้ลิมิต

159440.description:
After Irenea woke up as the chambermaid in a reverse harem game called "Love or Die," she thought she could get back home by seeing every good and bad game ending there could be. But she's still here! So this time, she wants to try leaving the Lavrenti family and the three young masters she serves, but they've all inexplicably fallen in love with her, even though she's just the game's "Save Point." So is the game now making Irenea the main character who has to choose who she loves and who dies?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The maid in the reverse harem game wants to quit
The Maid Wants to Quit Within the Reverse Harem Game
La Servante veut quitter le jeu de harem inversé

title.romaji: Yeok-harem Game Song Maid-neun Toesahago Sipseumnida

159441.description:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: PICK ME UP～低レア★英雄の成り上がり～

159442.description:
I have to survive, no matter what!

I've died and been reincarnated as the villain of a romance novel! In order to avoid the hideous fate that awaits me, I've righted her wrongs and even gotten engaged. I should be home free, but strange things have started happening ever since the heroine appeared. Why won't her fiancé leave me alone?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Case of the Legal Villain
Je suis devenue une vraie méchante
Me convertí en una verdadera villana

159443.description:
Following the death of the World Tree, all that stands between the apocalypse and salvation is the Divine Maiden, prophesied to restore peace and prosperity. But never mind all that. Princess Teriella Rufeon has more pressing issues at hand: her family keeps trying to kill her, she’s got a secret healing power to keep under wraps, and she’s just found out she’s being sent off to marry the infamous tyrant Emperor Rivanfel von Leonharta! But there’s more to Rivanfel than meets the eye, and Teriella discovers she isn’t the only one with a grave secret to hide…

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: คืนใหม่ สามีใหม่

159444.description:
An ordinary girl meets an extraordinary mage.

Asha lives a hard life with her alcoholic father. That is, until the day she meets a mysterious stranger who whisks her away and gives her everything she could ever want. Who is he? Why is he so kind? And why does he look at her as if he knows her? Asha wonders what secrets their past holds.

(Source: Manta)

159445.description:
I was a public official who worked part-time to survive. I was knocked out by a speeding car while making deliveries in the middle of the night. I have a strong memory of dying prematurely in a hit-and-run.

“…I’m Jo Hwi?”

At some point, I became the second son of the collapsing Jo Ga-Cheol Clan. This family has neither the authority to drop a flying bird nor the power to carry out one’s will. There is only an enormous amount of debt that can annihilate the entire family. There’s only one way out!

“Father, please pass the Jo Ga-Cheol Clan on to me.”

The story of a successful modern man who has to utilize all the knowledge and experience of a public official begins now.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Modern Man Who Fall Into Murim

Interesting facts about creatures you'll remember tomorrow!
But do you really need to say it in that way?
A slightly toxic heroine who is actually quite serious about the facts of life!

159449.description:
In a world where the Japanese people were almost completely wiped out by a dragon, Yahiro spends his lonely days working as a salvager in the ruins of Japan. One night, despite being gutted by a Moujuu, one of the monstrous beasts that roam the ruins, he makes it home without a scratch on him-just like he always does. But on that night, he finds he has unexpected guests-two twin girls named Giuli and Rosé. And this pair of supposed art dealers has a request for him...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Published in Comic Shingeki 2022-10

A sudden guest in the middle of the night turns out to be my neighbor?! And a secret deal offered from my old landlord!

(Source: Toomics)

159458.description:
Ryo wakes up one day to find himself transported to another world full of monster girls. Although their power far surpasses that of any humans. Ryo has his own ability--the "Charm" skill, which forcibly increases his affection level with all monster girls and builds a harem to get revenge on all the fantastical creatures that attacked and brought his home to ruin...!

(Source: Yen Press)

159459.description:
The Academy City, where "psychic power" is recognized as a "general science." Behind its peaceful facade lies a "shadow" organization undertaking missions too sensitive to be made public.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: とある暗部の少女共棲

159460.description:
One day a virgin guy, who is unaccustomed to dealing with girls, heads to his local convenience store andunexpectedly happens upon 3 gals from his class. Finding out that he lives nearby, the gals invite themselves over and barge into his place. No sooner than later do they start rummaging around his messy room for some entertainment. And entertainment they find... In the form of erotic mags and porno flicks! Naturally, the topic of conversation proceeds on to "How does one perform fellatio?" "If you lick like this, supposedly it feels really good for the guy." one of the gals says while licking her own finger as if it were a penis. Watching this all, the virgin guy is powerless to prevent himself from getting a rock hard boner. He tries to hide it from the gals, but his efforts are in vain...

(Source: DLsite)

159462.description:
"...I was interested in your body from the start."

To prep for his role in his next movie, the young actor Suga visits a tattoo parlor where he meets Hariya the tattooist. Though he knows it's for taking his measurements, Suga's body burns with passion at Hariya's seductive touches and gaze soaking up every inch of him. Then, as if teasing him, Hariya pushes Suga down, saying "I just had to touch you to be sure in the end." Mouth violated by Hariya's hot lips and cold tongue piercing, Suga's ravished by a pleasure he's never felt before...!

(Source: Book Walker)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

159463.description:
My childhood friend, who went away 3 years ago, is now performing on TV as a popular idol. And then I found out that the person who just moved into the room next to mine is the childhood friend herself, even as I'm watching her show!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Nationally Famous Idol, Who Turned Out to Be My Childhood Friend, Is Now My Neighbour
My Childhood Friend, Who Became a National Idol Moved into My Dingy Flat Next Door.

159464.description:
When Wataru’s parents passed away in a tragic accident, he found himself with no living relatives. Now, his resident maid, Kosame, is his only guardian. She’s as loyal as they come, and she’s been by Wataru’s side ever since he was young…but she’s not exactly human! As they live their lives together in the eclectic fishing village they call home, will Wataru manage to win her eternal love…?

(Source: Yen Press)

159467.description:
Arvis is a poor, low-achieving student at a remote magic school. One day, he was given the impossible task of defeating the smartest student in his school, or else he will be expelled. Arvis looks after his little sister who's blind and frail, and depends on the scholarship from the school to survive, so he started training as hard as he could! Not only did he not acomplish anything, he passed out from pushing himself too far. But then, he had a mysterious dream. In the dream, he was a legendary mage in his previous life, and was using the now extinct time magic to make quick work of demons! When Arvis woke up from the dream, he had the ability to use the legendary time magic?!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: Reincarnation of the Unrivalled Time Mage: The Underachiever at the Magic Academy Turns Out to Be the Strongest Mage Who Controls Time!

159469.description:
Attached at the hip for 20 years, Jiheon and Wooju are practically inseparable. There's definitely something simmering between them but Jiheon is an alpha and Wooju, just a beta. Not only that, but Wooju’s had his eyes on someone else lately, anyways. Ever the good friend, Jiheon makes an unexpected suggestion to Wooju in order to get the attention of the one he desires. But is there a layer of manipulation beneath this supposedly helpful gesture? What Jiheon feels is love, some might call…an obsession. And this obsession could lead to all sorts of trouble...

(Source: Lezhin US)

159470.description:
A girl who calls herself the Demon Lord falls onto an elementary school teacher living in the countryside, and they decide to get married!

A romantic comedy about a cute couple's life in the countryside, that happens to include the Demon Lord!

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

159473.description: One day, Megumi, who finds herself being pursued by an extermination squad, is rescued by Ares, a one-eared beastkin, and his friend Sou. Amidst their escape, it is revealed that Megumi possesses a unique constitution neither human nor beastkin. As her once stable life crumbles around her, Megumi is thrown into confusion but resolves to unravel the mysteries surrounding her.

title.native: 史上最強の宮廷テイマー ~自分を追い出して崩壊する王国を尻目に、辺境を開拓して使い魔たちの究極の楽園を作る~

159475.description:
Chicchi brothers who are exorcists who save people who are possessed by an unknown virus known as "Devil". Contagious through fear, this "devil" continues to move from person to person and cannot be eradicated by ordinary exorcists.
However, except for this brother, a rogue exorcist who is out of the Vatican's jurisdiction.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 悪魔はゆりかごを唄う

159476.description:
The demon-born seeds of this world will be retrieved. Everything is for the sake of the Goryo Shinju.
The "spirit world" where evil spirits of rivers and mountains live.
The "present world" where humans live.
And the "empty world" at the bottom of the earth: .......
The "empty world" is a cesspool of "dirt" that flows out of the present world.
Once upon a time, there was a sacred tree called "Goryojinju" in the land of the Yūrei.
It was in charge of guarding the entrance to the false world.
One day, it became very ill and a large amount of impurities overflowed into the world of the dead.
The god of protection lamented it so much that he blocked the entrance to the false world with his own life.
The stains were scattered into the present world as "demon-born seeds."
In order to return the demon seed to the sacred tree, a Chinese medicine doctor's journey begins.
synonyms: Higo no Kami : celui qui tisse les fleurs

159477.description:
Every burgeoning artist has to do a few things to advance in the business: regularly practice their art, work as an apprentice under a more talented and published artist, draw nude models to get form and function down… but Hiroshi never thought he would be the nude model! Hiroshi’s working for Miki Orihara, a popular manga-ka, and his job entails everything from drawing backgrounds, practicing forms, and stripping down! He may not be getting the lessons he want, but he’s the canvas that Miki and her fellow staff will paint his wildest dreams on.

(Source: Project-H)

title.english: The Pretty Manga-Ka and Her Slutty Assistants
title.native: 美人マンガ家とふしだらアシスタンツ
円交裏女と堕ちますか？

159479.description:
Yoshizawa Kana is a retired Taimanin living with her husband Shingo and son Satoru but now her demon hunting past catches up to her. Multiple women disappeared and Kana notices that all have been former Taimanin like herself.

Her fears become reality as a Mysterious Man infects her son's best friend, Kenya, with his demon magic, and the only way to save him is to give him sexual release. Even after asking for help by another active Taimanin, Sugita Karin, no better cure exist. Her necessary "cheating" slowly becomes her own desire and her obedience leads into Kenya's ownership.

(Source: Taimanin Fandom)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ママは対魔忍 THE COMIC

159480.description:
A female doctor runs into huge trouble and gets swept into political and harem issues when she transmigrates into another world and castrates a royal jerk. Not only does she have to take care of her useless disabled husband, she has to deal with the vicious two-faced royal princes as well. From eliminating the royals to plotting wicked schemes and flaunting her medical skills, she stuns everyone with her amazing abilities and knowledge. “Who says my husband is useless? From now on, I won’t forgive anyone who insults him!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes five extras chapters.

title.english: Bring It On, Your Royal Highnesses
title.romaji: Man Chao Wangye Yi Guo Duan

159482.description: Chiyo Takamura is a 30 year old woman currently working in the civil engineering department of a major construction company. Meanwhile, Ichika Seo is a 45 year old man who is the vice president of a foreign company. Ichika, who has feelings for Chiyo, confesses his feelings and asks her out on a date. However, Chiyo always thought of Ichika as a casual lunch buddy. As such, the two begin a trial period as a couple to see how their relationship will unfold.
synonyms: Will you let me love you with all my heart?

title.native: 全力で、愛していいかな？

159484.description:
I loved my brother's wife who died 7 years ago... And now, she has returned...!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

159485.description:
“Please help me… I’m stuck in time.”

Taesu, a former detective who runs a crime report agency, comes to meet with Minjung, a lady customer. Minjung makes a ridiculous request. Taesu tries to chase Minjung away after hearing her absurd statements of being constantly trapped in the same situation. But the next words he hears lead him with no other choice to believe this situation…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

159487.description:
It’s Christmas eve and Ju-hyeon has no one to spend it with. Her own daughter is too cool to spend it with her mom and so is everybody else at the police precinct Ju-hyeon works at.
